## DC Hub Intelligence (Remote)

The only MCP server combining data-center facility data, infrastructure, and live grid intelligence in one queryable interface. Covers 21,000+ facilities across 170+ countries, 232 US power markets (DC Hub Power Index), 2,000+ tracked M&A deals, 10 ISO grids, interconnection-queue snapshots, fiber routes, energy/gas pricing, water risk, and tax incentives. Built for data-center site selection, energy analysis, and market research. Free tier available (API key optional via the X-API-Key header).
